observations.body: Jesus appears among the gathered group, invites examination, eats fish, opens Scripture, names witness, and promises power from on high.
observations.label: Peace, wounds, food, Scripture, and promised power

observations.body: The passage presents Witnessing as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Witnessing

observations.body: The passage places Jesus beside Witnessing.
observations.label: Jesus

payload.posture: Read Luke 24:36–49 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus appears among the gathered group, invites examination, eats fish, opens Scripture, names witness, and promises power from on high. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
